verdict.rationale: Qapita documents issuing option grants under stock option plans and separately offers independent 409A valuations, so two components of the story exist as first-party capabilities. Nothing in the evidence shows a board approval flow, or the grant and the 409A strike price being linked in one end-to-end workflow. Missing for 10: board approval workflow, 409A valuation feeding the grant strike price, a documented single end-to-end new-hire grant flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue options to a new hire with a board approval flow and a 409A-compliant strike price in one end-to-end workflow

citations.quote: Set up and manage stock option plans, grants, vesting, and exercises globally.
Independent, audit-ready valuations from qualified experts with no shortcuts and no surprises.
Track, issue, and report equity with a single source of truth for founders, investors, and employees.
